# Puck: a flat glowing disc 0.28 across, 0.06 thick; origin at the bottom centre.
# Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Puck --base-color 0.9529 0.7608 0.1255 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Puck --vertices 10 --radius 0.14 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0 0.03
material assign Puck
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export puck.glb
